goals: Verify that the path generation functions (treeviewString, fileviewString, pullTreeviewString, pullFileviewString) correctly construct the expected URL path strings based on repository and pull request parameters
activities: Call treeviewString with owner 'foo' and repo 'bar' and assert it returns 'foo/bar/tree'
Call fileviewString with owner 'foo' and repo 'bar' and assert it returns 'foo/bar/blob'
Call pullTreeviewString with owner 'foo', repo 'bar', and pullId '123' and assert it returns 'foo/bar/pull/123/tree'
Call pullFileviewString with owner 'foo', repo 'bar', and pullId '123' and assert it returns 'foo/bar/pull/123/blob'
